name: NVG Sight Dimmer
teaser: Automatically dims sight and scope brightness when your NVGs are on — no more blinding reticles.
description_html:
Description

Automatically dims sight and scope reticle brightness when night vision goggles (NVGs) are active, preventing the reticle from blooming/washing out your view.

Features

  • Automatically detects when NVGs are turned on and dims sight brightness
  • Two independent F12 config sliders — one for holo/red-dot sights, one for magnified scope reticles
  • Toggle to enable/disable auto-dimming entirely
  • Brightness automatically restores to normal when NVGs are turned off
Install Instructions
  1. Extract the archive
  2. Drop the BepInEx folder into your SPT root directory
  3. Press F12 in-game to adjust brightness sliders if needed
Known Limitations / Bugs
  • ACOG-style prisms and scopes (e.g. Monstrum Compact Prism 2x32, TAC30) have their reticle baked into the lens as static art rather than a separate adjustable element, so their brightness cannot currently be adjusted by this mod.
  • The HHS-1 hybrid sight’s flip-up magnifier has no reticle of its own — it magnifies the existing holographic dot, which is dimmed correctly by the holo slider, but doesn’t reflect properly.
Support

Found a bug or have a question? Leave a comment on this mod’s page, or reach out in my thread on the SPT Discord: https://discord.com/channels/875684761291599922/1521972310595338260
